title: Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures
abstract: arXiv:2610.00564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences

translated_title: 用于重尾测度间映射学习的注意力核
translated_abstract: 概率测度上的算子学习可以通过Transformer来实现。然而，对于具有多项式尾部的测度，softmax中的指数加权可能导致相应的测度级注意力积分发散。这促使我们用增长更慢的函数来替换指数函数。我们构建了两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准，并利用这些基准研究了post-norm Transformer中注意力核的增长特性与数据变换的作用。在不进行数据变换的情况下，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上均出现集成坍塌，而三种增长更慢的核则避免了坍塌。Symlog预处理使softmax能够在矩阵求逆任务上避免坍塌，但在剪切交换任务上则无法避免。在高斯对照实验中，四种核的表现相近。我们还考察了样本量如何影响经验能量和Wasserstein距离对尾部差异的敏感性。
tldr: 针对重尾概率测度上softmax指数加权导致注意力积分发散和模型集成坍塌的问题，该论文提出以增长更慢的核函数替代指数核，并构建两个闭式目标基准验证了慢增长核的稳定性优势。
en_tdlr: To address softmax attention integral divergence and ensemble collapse on heavy-tailed probability measures, this paper proposes replacing the exponential kernel with slower-growing kernels and validates their stability advantages on two closed-form operator learning benchmarks.
